from_speaker: generative AI doesn't really automate many tasks
our_interpretation: Assess the task-automation proposition, not the surrounding allegation about advocates' intentions.
The plain reading is that generative AI completes only a limited range of work tasks without people performing or repairing substantial parts of them.
Task automation is distinct from assistance, adoption, and replacement of whole jobs. High volume on one task does not establish a broad range of automated tasks.
Use April–June 2024, the latest completed quarter before publication, for this ongoing-state observation.

The retrospective study reports roughly 60% success for 2024-Q2 models on text tasks taking humans about 1.5 hours. This is material evidence of broad capability, but selected text-task evaluations do not establish reliable automation in actual workplaces.
